# UK Parliament Thesaurus — non-English / non-ASCII label review

_Generated 2026-06-17 from the stopgap release (`fpkg.fly.dev/kgx/parliament-lda-terms.ttl`, 130,178 terms; labels ~92% complete)._

**Policy:** labels default to **English** (`@en`, as published upstream); a label that mixes languages is left as English. This file is the *intermediate inspection data*: every label whose text contains a **diacritic / non-ASCII character** is listed for review (the cheap proxy for "might be non-English"). The vast majority are **accented proper nouns** — foreign place/organisation/person names that are legitimate entries in an English thesaurus and stay `@en`. Only a label that is wholly a non-English *phrase* is a candidate to retag; add those to `LANG_OVERRIDE` in `tools/parliament-lda-type.mjs`.
